mapper.select:
SELECT S.SUBSYS_NM , C.COM_CD_ID , M.COM_CD_NM , C.DEL_YN AS DEL_YN , YN.DTL_CD_NM AS DEL_YN_NM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL D WHERE D.COM_CD_ID = C.COM_CD_ID) AS DTL_CD_CNT , C.CRT_DT , C.UPDT_DT FROM FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD C LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_SUBSYS S ON S.SUBSYS_CD = C.SUBSYS_CD LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG M ON M.COM_CD_ID = C.COM_CD_ID AND M.MLNG_LANG_CD = NVL(#{mlngLangCd}, 'KO') LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG YN ON YN.COM_CD_ID = 'CD0179' AND YN.DTL_CD = C.DEL_YN AND YN.MLNG_LANG_CD = NVL(#{mlngLangCd}, 'KO') WHERE 1 = 1
AND C.SUBSYS_CD = #{subsysCd}
AND C.COM_CD_ID LIKE '%' || #{comCdId} || '%'
AND M.COM_CD_NM LIKE '%' || #{comCdNm} || '%'
AND C.DEL_YN = #{delYn}
ORDER BY C.CRT_DT DESC, C.COM_CD_ID
OFFSET #{startNo} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{listCount} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD ( COM_CD_ID, COM_CD_LEN, SUBSYS_CD, SYS_COM_CD_YN, DEL_YN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{comCdId}, #{comCdLen}, #{subsysCd}, NVL(#{sysComCdYn}, 'N'), NVL(#{delYn}, 'N'), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId} )

INSERT ALL INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG (COM_CD_ID, MLNG_LANG_CD, COM_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{comCdId}, 'KO', NVL(#{comCdNm}, ' '), NVL(#{comCdExpln}, ' '), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId}) INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG (COM_CD_ID, MLNG_LANG_CD, COM_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{comCdId}, 'EN', NVL(#{comCdNm}, ' '), NVL(#{comCdExpln}, ' '), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId}) INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG (COM_CD_ID, MLNG_LANG_CD, COM_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{comCdId}, 'ZH', NVL(#{comCdNm}, ' '), NVL(#{comCdExpln}, ' '), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId}) SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT C.COM_CD_ID , C.COM_CD_LEN , C.SUBSYS_CD , C.SYS_COM_CD_YN , C.DEL_YN , C.CRT_USER_ID , C.UPDT_USER_ID , C.CRT_DT , C.UPDT_DT , M_KO.COM_CD_NM AS COM_CD_NM_KO , M_KO.COM_CD_EXPLN AS COM_CD_EXPLN_KO , M_EN.COM_CD_NM AS COM_CD_NM_EN , M_EN.COM_CD_EXPLN AS COM_CD_EXPLN_EN , M_ZH.COM_CD_NM AS COM_CD_NM_ZH , M_ZH.COM_CD_EXPLN AS COM_CD_EXPLN_ZH FROM FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD C LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG M_KO ON M_KO.COM_CD_ID = C.COM_CD_ID AND M_KO.MLNG_LANG_CD = 'KO' LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG M_EN ON M_EN.COM_CD_ID = C.COM_CD_ID AND M_EN.MLNG_LANG_CD = 'EN' LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG M_ZH ON M_ZH.COM_CD_ID = C.COM_CD_ID AND M_ZH.MLNG_LANG_CD = 'ZH' WHERE C.COM_CD_ID = #{comCdId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL ( COM_CD_ID, DTL_CD, SORT_SEQ, DEL_YN, APLCN_BGNG_YND, APLEN_END_YMD, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID ) VALUES ( #{comCdId}, #{dtlCd}, #{sortSeq}, NVL(#{delYn}, 'N'), NVL(#{aplcnBgngYnd}, '19000101'), NVL(#{aplcnEndYmd}, '99991231'), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId} )

INSERT ALL INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG (COM_CD_ID, DTL_CD, MLNG_LANG_CD, DTL_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{comCdId}, #{dtlCd}, 'KO', NVL(#{dtlCdNm}, ' '), NVL(#{dtlCdExpln}, ' '), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId}) INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG (COM_CD_ID, DTL_CD, MLNG_LANG_CD, DTL_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{comCdId}, #{dtlCd}, 'EN', NVL(#{dtlCdNm}, ' '), NVL(#{dtlCdExpln}, ' '), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId}) INTO FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG (COM_CD_ID, DTL_CD, MLNG_LANG_CD, DTL_CD_NM, COM_CD_EXPLN, CRT_USER_ID, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{comCdId}, #{dtlCd}, 'ZH', NVL(#{dtlCdNm}, ' '), NVL(#{dtlCdExpln}, ' '), #{crtUserId}, #{updtUserId}) SELECT 1 FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT D.COM_CD_ID , M.COM_CD_NM , D.DTL_CD , D.SORT_SEQ , D.DEL_YN , DM_KO.DTL_CD_NM AS DTL_CD_NM_KO , DM_KO.COM_CD_EXPLN AS DTL_CD_EXPLN_KO , DM_EN.DTL_CD_NM AS DTL_CD_NM_EN , DM_EN.COM_CD_EXPLN AS DTL_CD_EXPLN_EN , DM_ZH.DTL_CD_NM AS DTL_CD_NM_ZH , DM_ZH.COM_CD_EXPLN AS DTL_CD_EXPLN_ZH , D.CRT_USER_ID , D.CRT_DT , D.UPDT_USER_ID , D.UPDT_DT FROM FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL D LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_MLNG M ON M.COM_CD_ID = D.COM_CD_ID AND M.MLNG_LANG_CD = NVL(#{mlngLangCd}, 'KO') LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG DM_KO ON DM_KO.COM_CD_ID = D.COM_CD_ID AND DM_KO.DTL_CD = D.DTL_CD AND DM_KO.MLNG_LANG_CD = 'KO' LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG DM_EN ON DM_EN.COM_CD_ID = D.COM_CD_ID AND DM_EN.DTL_CD = D.DTL_CD AND DM_EN.MLNG_LANG_CD = 'EN' LEFT JOIN FMSOWN.TB_SCM_COM_CD_DTL_MLNG DM_ZH ON DM_ZH.COM_CD_ID = D.COM_CD_ID AND DM_ZH.DTL_CD = D.DTL_CD AND DM_ZH.MLNG_LANG_CD = 'ZH' WHERE D.COM_CD_ID = #{comCdId} AND D.DTL_CD = #{dtlCd}
